clue.text: Collected essential item before start of day

parts.note: a must is something essential, as in 'a must for any traveller'
ere is a poetic word for before

indicators.note: start of means only the opening letter of the word day is used

explanation.surface: Someone gathers a vital item before the day gets going.
explanation.definitionFit: To muster is to gather or assemble, so the past tense matches gathered.

clue.text: Some Parisian in test shown to be of limited ability

indicators.note: in means the French word goes inside the abbreviation for the test

parts.note: the MOT is Britain's annual roadworthiness test for vehicles
des is French for some

explanation.surface: A French examinee proves not very able in a test.
explanation.walkthrough: The MOT is the yearly safety check British cars must pass.
explanation.definitionFit: Modest can mean moderate or unremarkable, as in modest talent or modest means.

clue.text: More than one upset disappears finally with tablets

indicators.note: finally means only the last letter of disappears is taken

parts.note: pills are tablets

explanation.surface: Someone disturbed fades away, with medication.
explanation.definitionFit: Spills are accidents in which things are knocked over, so upsets in the plural noun sense.

clue.text: No longer very good, a fellow must be paid for

parts.note: ex means former, no longer
pi is slang for pious, very good
Ted is a man's name, any fellow

explanation.surface: A man who has lost his virtue must atone.
explanation.definitionFit: Expiated means atoned for, making amends for a wrong, as in paying for one's sins.

clue.text: Wise, releasing one bird

indicators.note: releasing means the letter for one is let go from the comedian's name

parts.note: Ernie Wise was half of the British comedy duo Morecambe and Wise
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A wise person lets a bird go free.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wise' looks like an adjective but is the surname of the comedian Ernie Wise.
explanation.definitionFit: The erne is the white-tailed sea eagle, a crossword favourite among birds.

clue.text: Rule-breakers in Civil Service full of passion

indicators.note: full of means the abbreviation holds the other piece inside it

parts.note: heat, as in the heat of the moment, means passion

explanation.surface: Passionate civil servants are caught breaking the rules.
explanation.definitionFit: Those who cheat break the rules of a game or exam; a plural noun for both.

clue.text: Old soldiers covered in grass cheer

indicators.note: covered in means the old soldiers are wrapped inside the dried grass

parts.note: hay is dried grass
OR, other ranks, means soldiers who are not officers

explanation.surface: Veterans buried in the grass give a shout of joy.
explanation.definitionFit: Hooray is a shout of delight, a cheer.

clue.text: Cunning US composer making records

parts.note: arch means sly or cunning
Charles Ives was an American composer

explanation.surface: A crafty American composer cuts some albums.
explanation.definitionFit: Archives are collections of historical documents, kept records.

clue.text: Bad musician sang — vile wobbling

indicators.note: wobbling suggests the letters shaking into a fresh order

explanation.surface: A dreadful singer's voice wavers horribly.
explanation.definitionFit: Svengali, in du Maurier's novel Trilby, is a sinister musician who controls a singer by hypnosis.

clue.text: Fat and very sweaty?

definitions.meaning: fat that runs from roasting meat, kept for cooking
soaked through with sweat, as if wet enough to drip

explanation.surface: A description of an overweight person who perspires heavily.
explanation.definitionFit: Meat fat collected in the roasting tin has a traditional name; someone wringing wet is said to be that too.

clue.text: Endlessly noisy revolutionary seen as sinister

indicators.note: endlessly means the synonym for noisy loses its final letter

parts.note: loud means noisy
Che Guevara is the crossword's stock revolutionary

explanation.surface: A loud rebel comes across as a shady character.
explanation.definitionFit: Louche means disreputable or shady, close to the sense of sinister as shifty and untrustworthy.

clue.text: Little woman with trophy given a line in diary

parts.note: Jo March is one of the sisters in Little Women
an urn can be a trophy, as in cricket's Ashes urn

explanation.surface: A small woman is handed a cup and writes a line in her diary.
explanation.definitionFit: A journal is a daily written record, the same thing as a diary.

clue.text: First day during which army officer meets a ruler

indicators.note: during which means the officer and the a sit inside the day's abbreviation

parts.note: Sunday, abbreviated SUN, is the first day of the week
Lt is short for lieutenant

explanation.surface: On the first day an officer is presented to a monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: A sultan is a Muslim sovereign, so a ruler in the plain sense.

clue.text: Searching for silver and fashionable glitter (not rubbish!)

parts.note: taken as written
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
in means fashionable

indicators.note: not means the synonym for rubbish is taken out of the word glitter

parts.note: litter is rubbish

explanation.surface: Someone hunts for silver and stylish sparkle, rejecting the junk.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing LITTER (rubbish) from GLITTER leaves just G.
explanation.definitionFit: Foraging is hunting about for food or provisions, so it is a form of searching.

clue.text: How poetry may be written upside down

definitions.meaning: poetry is set out in lines and stanzas, read as two words
turned over, opposite in order or direction

explanation.surface: Verse can be written the wrong way up.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as two words the answer says how poems are written; as one word it means reversed.
explanation.definitionFit: Inverse means reversed or opposite in position, turned upside down.

clue.text: Rebrand drunk as saintly man

indicators.note: drunk suggests letters staggering into a new order

explanation.surface: A tipsy rebranding presents someone as a saint.
explanation.definitionFit: Saint Bernard of Clairvaux and Saint Bernard of Menthon are well-known holy men with this name.

clue.text: Laze around to show this? Yes and no!

definitions.text: Laze around to show this? Yes and no!

indicators.note: around suggests the letters of laze turned about into a new order

explanation.surface: A paradox: can idling about display keenness?
explanation.walkthrough: Yes, because the letters of LAZE rearranged give the answer; no, because lazing is the opposite of keenness.
explanation.definitionFit: The clue's 'this' is enthusiasm, the opposite quality of lazing, which the 'no' acknowledges.

clue.text: Confession of one who has left spouse gets communicated

definitions.text: Confession of one who has left spouse
definitions.meaning: split into words, a separated person admitting the split
passed on, made known, as information

explanation.surface: A separated person's admission gets passed around.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as I'M PARTED, it is what a separated person would confess.
explanation.definitionFit: To impart is to pass on information, so imparted means communicated.

clue.text: Have a quick look at part of stadium? It's barer

parts.note: to scan is to glance over quickly
a tier is a row of seating in a stadium

explanation.surface: Someone glances at a stand and finds it emptier.
explanation.definitionFit: Scantier means more meagre, less covered, so barer.

clue.text: Shivering, having caught cold? Don't trust charlatan doing this!

indicators.note: having caught means the shivering word takes the cold letter inside it

parts.note: quaking means shivering or trembling

explanation.surface: A warning about a feverish fraud.
explanation.walkthrough: A quack is a charlatan, so a quack's characteristic activity is fittingly named; the definition plays on that word.
explanation.definitionFit: Quack is slang for a fake doctor, and what a quack does is punningly named after a duck's call.

clue.text: Staff provided with something spicy

definitions.meaning: a ceremonial staff of office carried before an official
a spice made from the outer covering of nutmeg

explanation.surface: Employees are given something hot to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: The ceremonial club and the nutmeg spice share one spelling.

clue.text: Group of stars being quiet, say, like you and me

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical mark for quiet
e.g., for example, is signalled by say
as means like
us is you and me

explanation.surface: Celebrities keep quiet, the clue says, just as we do.
explanation.definitionFit: Pegasus is a constellation of the northern sky, named for the winged horse.

clue.text: Place in which one may hide a sweetheart, roughly bundled in!

definitions.text: Place in which one may hide

indicators.note: bundled in means the abbreviation for roughly is pushed inside

parts.note: love is a term for a sweetheart
c, short for circa, means roughly

explanation.surface: A hiding spot where a lover might be stashed away.
explanation.definitionFit: An alcove is a recess in a wall, a nook where someone could tuck themselves out of sight.

clue.text: Obvious time for mournful song

parts.note: plain means obvious, clear

explanation.surface: It is clearly time for a lament.
explanation.definitionFit: A plaint is a lament, an expression of grief in verse or song.

clue.text: One sort of designer, a hundred in number

indicators.note: in means the Roman hundred goes inside the anaesthetic

parts.note: ether is a number, something that numbs, an old anaesthetic
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: A designer turns out to be one of a hundred.
explanation.walkthrough: 'number' is read as numb-er, something that numbs: ether.
explanation.definitionFit: An etcher creates designs by etching acid into metal plates, so is a type of artist.

clue.text: A new name on a rota — one keeps a record

parts.note: a rota is a list of duties

explanation.surface: A fresh name goes on the duty roster, which someone keeps up to date.
explanation.definitionFit: An annalist writes annals, year-by-year historical records.

clue.text: Cat getting round church parking area?

parts.note: O is round in shape
CE is the Church of England
a lot is a parking area, as in a car lot

explanation.surface: A cat prowls around a church car park.
explanation.definitionFit: The ocelot is a spotted wild cat of the Americas.

clue.text: Bard's expression of final wishes

definitions.meaning: the Bard is Shakespeare, whose first name this is, with 's read as is
a legal document stating how property passes after death

explanation.surface: Shakespeare's last testament.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's first name matches the legal testament; his famous will left his second-best bed to his wife.

clue.text: Make clothes for dog with yellow attachment

parts.note: to dog someone is to follow them, to tail them
or is the heraldic word for gold or yellow

explanation.surface: Someone sews outfits for a pet, with a yellow accessory.
explanation.definitionFit: To tailor is to cut and sew garments to fit someone, a verb taking an object.

clue.text: Female style of Sixties attire facing quiet decline

parts.note: Di is a woman's name, short for Diana
the miniskirt, or mini, was the fashion of the 1960s
sh is a call for quiet

explanation.surface: A woman in a Sixties outfit faces a quiet fall from favour.
explanation.definitionFit: To diminish is to lessen or dwindle, a verb matching decline.

clue.text: Sort of beetle group found in coastal county

parts.note: the dor is a kind of dung beetle
a set is a group

explanation.surface: A colony of beetles turns up in a seaside region.
explanation.definitionFit: Dorset is a county on England's south coast, home of the Jurassic Coast.

clue.text: Stern of this boat is less sturdy

indicators.note: the stern is the back of a boat, so the last letter of the word this

parts.note: a lighter is a flat-bottomed barge

explanation.surface: The rear of a vessel is weaker than the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Slighter means slimmer or frailer, so less robust in build.
